name: Arcane Trickster

source.note: PHB-only subclass entered from knowledge; check against the book.

summary: Mixes Wizard illusions and enchantments with an invisible Mage Hand for remote larceny.

feature.name: Spellcasting
feature.summary: Cast Wizard spells with Intelligence: Mage Hand plus two cantrips, three prepared spells.
feature.text: You know Mage Hand and two other Wizard cantrips (one more at level 10) and prepare level 1+ Wizard spells as shown in the Arcane Trickster table; whenever you gain a Rogue level you can swap one cantrip (not Mage Hand) and one prepared spell. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability; an Arcane Focus can be your focus.

feature.name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
feature.summary: Your Mage Hand is invisible and can pick locks, disarm traps and pick pockets at range.
feature.text: When you cast Mage Hand, the hand is Invisible, and you can control it as a Bonus Action. Through it you can stow or retrieve an object in a container worn or carried by another creature, and use Thieves' Tools or Sleight of Hand to pick locks and disarm traps at range.

feature.name: Magical Ambush
feature.summary: While you're Invisible, a creature has Disadvantage on saves against your spells this turn.

feature.name: Versatile Trickster
feature.summary: Use Trip through your Mage Hand on a creature within 5 feet of it.

feature.name: Spell Thief
feature.summary: Reaction: stop a spell cast at you and steal it for 8 hours.
